exposure: Epidural ropivacaine with esketamine (0.2 mg ml-1)
Epidural ropivacaine with esketamine (0.3 mg ml-1)
Epidural ropivacaine with esketamine (0.4 mg ml-1)
Epidural ropivacaine with esketamine (0.5 mg ml-1)
cohort: One hundred and fifty parturients who requested epidural analgesia were recruited.
finding: The addition of epidural esketamine at concentrations of 0.3 mg mL-1, 0.4 mg mL-1, and 0.5 mg mL-1 provided a similar ropivacaine dose-sparing effect, with 0.5 mg mL-1 esketamine producing more adverse effects.
mod_finding: No differences in the percentage of caesarean delivery were found among the groups receiving different esketamine concentrations.
